model_name: AgriNexus Leaf Disease Computer Vision Classifier

tomato_healthy.description: Foliage exhibits vigorous chlorophyll pigmentation, uniform leaf lamina, and no necrotic lesions.
tomato_healthy.treatment: Maintain regular drip irrigation and preventive bio-fungicide sprays (Trichoderma viride).

tomato_early_blight.description: Concentric dark brown rings with chlorotic yellow halos appearing primarily on older lower leaves.
tomato_early_blight.treatment: Apply Chlorothalonil or Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2g/L. Prune infected lower foliage to enhance air circulation.

tomato_late_blight.description: Water-soaked irregular dark lesions rapidly expanding into greasy brown necrosis with white fungal fuzz underneath in damp weather.
tomato_late_blight.treatment: Emergency spray of Metalaxyl-M + Mancozeb (Ridomil Gold) @ 2.5g/L. Avoid overhead sprinkler irrigation.

potato_early_blight.description: Target-board circular dark brown spots surrounded by chlorotic yellow margins on lower leaves.
potato_early_blight.treatment: Spray Azoxystrobin 23% SC @ 1ml/L or Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 3g/L at 10-day intervals.

potato_late_blight.description: Rapidly spreading dark purple to black water-soaked lesions leading to complete foliage collapse.
potato_late_blight.treatment: Apply Cymoxanil 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP @ 2.5g/L immediately. Destroy cull piles and infected tubers.

potato_healthy.description: Deep green compound leaves with crisp margins and absence of foliar pathogens.
potato_healthy.treatment: Ensure well-drained raised beds and balanced potassium nutrition for tuber resilience.

corn_common_rust.description: Cinnamon-brown powdery pustules erupting across both upper and lower leaf surfaces.
corn_common_rust.treatment: Foliar application of Tebuconazole 25.9% EC @ 1ml/L or Propiconazole 25% EC @ 1ml/L.

corn_leaf_blight.description: Long, elliptical cigar-shaped grayish-green to tan lesions extending along leaf veins.
corn_leaf_blight.treatment: Spray Pyraclostrobin 20% WG @ 1g/L. Rotate with non-grass crops and practice deep tillage.

rice_leaf_blast.description: Spindle-shaped diamond lesions with gray or white centers and brown to reddish-brown margins.
rice_leaf_blast.treatment: Apply Tricyclazole 75% WP @ 0.6g/L or Isoprothiolane 40% EC @ 1.5ml/L. Avoid excessive nitrogen fertilizer.

rice_brown_spot.description: Small, oval, dark brown spots fairly evenly distributed across the leaf blade.
rice_brown_spot.treatment: Ensure balanced potash application (MOP). Foliar spray of Propiconazole 25% EC @ 1ml/L.

cotton_bacterial_blight.description: Angular water-soaked leaf spots bound by leaf veinlets, turning reddish-brown.
cotton_bacterial_blight.treatment: Spray Copper Oxychloride 50% WP (2.5g/L) mixed with Streptomycin Sulphate (0.1g/L).

cotton_healthy.description: Vibrant palmate foliage with no discoloration or vein necrosis.
cotton_healthy.treatment: Standard integrated pest management (IPM) and balanced micronutrient fertilization.

dataset_source: PlantVillage & International Crop Foliar Pathology Reference Standards
limitations: Model works best with clear, well-lit single-leaf images against uniform backgrounds. Extreme shadow occlusion or blur reduces confidence.
